orbrey_mcp_url.description: Orbrey MCP server URL (e.g. https://mcp.orbrey.app/mcp). Defaults to the production worker.

orbrey_oauth_token.description: OAuth bearer token for the orbrey-mcp worker. Generate via the Orbrey app's Settings → Integrations screen.

default_household_id.description: Default household UUID to target when a skill does not specify one explicitly. Optional — when unset, skills will list available households.
